## Question

Link the topic and issue this addresses.

## Evidence

What changed? Distinguish source claims, measured results and proposals. Negative or inconclusive results are welcome.

## Reproduction

Commands, versions, seeds, public data identifiers, compute cost and limitations.

## Checks

- [ ] Primary sources are cited; exact quotes are short and attributed.
- [ ] No private footage, credentials, personal data or copied paper figures are included.
- [ ] Relevant code, model, weight and dataset licenses are recorded separately.
- [ ] Topic metadata/checklists match the evidence; `npm run build` and `npm test` pass.
